title: Black Jack Chewing Gum (5 Sticks)
body:
Limited Edition Vintage Gum!

Candy Funhouse is known for carrying vintage candies but with Black Jack Chewing Gum, you can be transported to the 19th century instantly! The Black Jack chewing gum was initially made in 1871 as a flavorless gum, but then evolved to the licorice flavor we all recognize today in 1884. 

There’s actually a really cool timeline associated with this historic gum!

For instance, the Black Jack Chewing Gum was actually the first flavored gum, and the first stick gum ever made! It was sold for more than 90 years until it was discontinued in 1978, and then brought back in 1985, and then in 2005 for a limited time. Fortunately for Candy Funhouse customers, they have come back for a limited time (again) and we are selling this nostalgic product right here!
